title: GJU 3030
description:
A comprehensive graduation project at the German Jordanian University focused on applying computer science knowledge to a real-world problem through research, system design, implementation, testing, and evaluation.

As part of the project, I worked on **Visual Sentinel – AI Stereo Vision Drone Detection System**, an AI-powered computer vision system designed to detect drones and estimate their spatial position using stereo vision, deep learning, camera calibration, and sensor data.

The project involved:
• Computer Vision & Object Detection
• Deep Learning and YOLO
• Stereo Vision & 3D Localization
• Sensor/IMU and GPS Data Integration
• Python & AI Model Development
• System Design, Testing & Evaluation
• Research, Documentation & Technical Presentation
